label: chrome-devtools
message: chrome remote debugging is not reachable at http://127.0.0.1:9222/json/version. On macOS, prefer launching a fresh instance with: open -na "Google Chrome" --args --remote-debugging-port=9222 --user-data-dir=/tmp/chrome-mcp . If an old Chrome process is blocking the args, first run: pkill -f "Google Chrome" . The agent can use the bash tool to run these commands
